capabilities: Scan the current note for lines starting with TODO or list variants like "- TODO"
Consolidate matched lines under a TODOs section at the end of the note
Configure the keyword used for matching in settings
Run the wrangling from the command palette or ribbon icon
disambiguation: Not a task manager; it only moves lines starting with a keyword to a section at the end of the note.
problem: TODO lines scattered throughout a note are hard to find and review in one place.
summary: Plugin that scans the current note for lines starting with a configurable keyword and consolidates them under a TODOs section at the end of the note.
